title: Where Buddy Petit's last jobs took place, and his real name
summary: The interviewer cites two books on the picnic where Buddy Petit played last. Lewis corrects it and they discuss his real name, Crawford.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
